faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Amritsar District Aspirational Block Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Amritsar District Aspirational Block Fellow position is 20th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Aspirational Block Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in any discipline from a reputed institution. Additionally, skills in data analysis, presentation, project management, and familiarity with social media are essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Aspirational Block Fellow post is between 25 years and 40 years as of 1st August 2026. Age relaxation rules will be applied as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Aspirational Block Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Aspirational Block Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 55,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the Amritsar District Aspirational Block Fellow recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Aspirational Block Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Aspirational Block Fellow post in Amritsar District.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key skills required for this role?
faq.answer: Key skills include data analysis, presentation, project management, good communication, self-drive, and the ability to read, write, and speak Punjabi. Experience with a development organization is also beneficial.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Aspirational Block Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications, assessment and interview, an on-the-spot assignment, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Amritsar District, which is https://amritsar.nic.in/.
